paper.title_en: On the triple nature of the PSR J0435+3233 system
paper.abstract_en: Context. The recent pulsar timing ephemeris of PSR J0435+3233 indicates that this millisecond pulsar (MSP) has a spin-down rate that is much higher than observed in other MSPs and challenges our understanding of the formation and evolution of MSPs. Aims. We propose that this system is a hierarchical triple, and that the high spin-down rate is caused by varying acceleration due to a tertiary in a wide orbit. Methods. We use pulsar timing methods with radio and gamma-ray observations of PSR J0435+3233 to determine the system properties. Results. We find that a hierarchical triple timing model describes the timing observations of PSR J0435+3233 and that this results in the detection of gamma-ray pulsations back to the beginning of the Fermi Large Area Telescope (LAT) data in 2008. The intrinsic spin-down rate remains uncertain as it correlates with the parameters of the outer orbit, but large spin-down rates are excluded and the intrinsic rate is at least two orders of magnitude lower than the observed rate, in line with other Galactic MSPs. We identify a star located 11 mas from the pulsar position as the optical counterpart to the tertiary companion. From the 1.5-2.5 kpc distance and colours, we infer that the tertiary is a 1.2 solar mass F-type main-sequence star. Along with the pulsar binary, it orbits the common centre of mass with an eccentric (e ~ 0.6), wide (~ 70 yr) orbit that is likely seen at a low orbital inclination. Conclusions. We conclude that PSR J0435+3233 is a hierarchical triple system. We discuss the motivation and prospects for the continued study of this system. Spectral measurements of the outer star in addition to continued astrometric measurements will yield mass ratio and inclination estimates, while continued pulsar timing may yield a tighter constraint on violations of the Strong Equivalence Principle than are currently obtained from PSR J0337+1715.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文提出PSR J0435+3233是一个层级三星系统，其高自转减慢率由外在伴星引起，并利用脉冲星计时和伽马射线观测验证。研究结果对理解毫秒脉冲星演化和强等效原理检验有重要意义，且属于脉冲星计时阵列相关领域。
decision.title_zh: 关于PSR J0435+3233系统的三重性质
decision.abstract_zh: 背景。PSR J0435+3233的最新脉冲星计时星历表表明，这颗毫秒脉冲星（MSP）的自转减慢率远高于其他MSP中观测到的值，这对我们理解MSP的形成和演化提出了挑战。目的。我们提出该系统是一个层级三星系统，其高自转减慢率是由于一个宽轨道上的第三体引起的加速度变化造成的。方法。我们使用脉冲星计时方法以及PSR J0435+3233的射电和伽马射线观测来确定系统性质。结果。我们发现，一个层级三星计时模型描述了PSR J0435+3233的计时观测，并且这导致伽马射线脉冲探测回溯到2008年费米大面积望远镜（LAT）数据的开始时刻。固有自转减慢率仍然不确定，因为它与外轨道的参数相关，但大的自转减慢率被排除，固有速率比观测速率低至少两个数量级，与其他银河系MSP一致。我们确定了位于脉冲星位置11毫角秒处的一颗恒星作为第三体伴星的光学对应体。根据1.5-2.5千秒差距的距离和颜色，我们推断第三体是一颗1.2太阳质量的F型主序星。它与脉冲星双星一起，以偏心（e~0.6）、宽（~70年）的轨道绕共同质心运行，该轨道可能以低轨道倾角观测。结论。我们得出结论，PSR J0435+3233是一个层级三星系统。我们讨论了继续研究该系统的动机和前景。外层恒星的光谱测量以及持续的天体测量测量将产生质量比和倾角估计，而持续的脉冲星计时可能对强等效原理违例产生比目前从PSR J0337+1715获得的更严格的约束。
